review_kind: Independent source and preserved-evidence audit; no duplicated full-design simulations
checks: Exact operation/level/vector completion sets with no duplicates or omissions
Positive reported cycle counts, terminal markers, and zero simulator return codes for each of five operation suites
Selected inputs, staged design, testbenches, and executable hashes independently rechecked
Original candidate overrides and pinned upstream files retained unchanged
flag_polarity: combined_top verification data_o is active-high failure: 0=accepted, 1=rejected. Upstream mismatch display swaps Expected/received labels, but !== comparator is correct.

original_failures.malformed_hint: ML-DSA-87 valid-vector index 4 final hint count changes50->51, appending duplicate index0 after179 within final polynomial. Original baseline and candidate accepted; finite mutation suite fails. Canonical-hints variant rejects.
original_failures.candidate_encoder: Original banked encoder delays an empty-FIFO output word relative to reference, stalls Sign under the existing drain schedule; watchdog failure preserved. Pinned-encoder substitution is diagnostic only.

canonical_guard_independent_check.oracle: FIPS 204 Algorithm 21, independently implemented encoding predicates

evidence_limits: Full design uses GHDL6-generated Keccak netlist plus Verilator5.49 two-state simulation; no formal source/netlist equivalence.
Pinned upstream KAT expected outputs are byte-compared; official ACVP provenance is not independently authenticated here.
Full-design Icarus attempt times out without completion; guard and encoder four-state results are narrower checks.
Encoder check uses default parameters and bounded legal-envelope input/backpressure; no reset-pending, arbitrary-backpressure or exhaustive proof.
Canonical full-design cases reset between vectors; no no-reset reuse claim.
No side-channel, FIPS certification, FPGA/ASIC timing or PPA claim.
legacy_acceptance_scope: chip_orchestrator metadata now labels mldsa_keygen_75 explicitly and excludes Sign/Verify; no portable profile is inferred from the historical75 cases.

export_review.validator: Exact named variant, five suite keys, unique vectors and integer counts/indices/cycles/return codes; bool/float metadata rejected
export_review.sources: Both default Verilog exports reconstruct the tested RTL/netlist hashes exactly; mixed exports explicitly retain unqualified direct VHDL-source equivalence
export_review.focused_tests: 28 normal portable/source/export/legacy-scope tests; 5 export tests under Python -O
